message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
trace = [
  {"step":1,"file":"flac-fuzzers/fuzzer_decoder.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":126,"var":"data,size","code":"fuzzing::datasource::Datasource ds(data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes become the datasource that drives decoder configuration and input bytes."},
  {"step":2,"file":"flac-fuzzers/fuzzer_decoder.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":131,"var":"ret","code":"ret = decoder.init_ogg();","note":"The PoC selects Ogg/stream initialization so the decoder starts consuming the crafted input through the stream callbacks."},
  {"step":3,"file":"flac-fuzzers/fuzzer_decoder.cpp","function":"FuzzerStream::read_callback","line":44,"var":"buffer,bytes","code":"const size_t maxCopySize = *bytes; ... memcpy(buffer, data.data(), copySize);","note":"The read callback copies attacker bytes into the decoder's bitreader buffer and reports the number of bytes available."},
  {"step":4,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_residual_partitioned_rice_","line":2773,"var":"residual + sample","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block(decoder->private_->input, residual + sample, u, rice_parameter)) return false;","note":"A crafted frame with Rice-coded residuals routes parsing into the bitreader's Rice block reader."},
  {"step":5,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":787,"var":"b","code":"b = br->buffer[cwords] << br->consumed_bits;","note":"The bitreader reuses partially consumed buffered words while decoding unary and binary Rice fields."},
  {"step":6,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":792,"var":"x,y","code":"x = y = COUNT_ZERO_MSBS2(b);","note":"The decoder counts leading zero bits to find the unary stop bit in attacker-controlled data."},
  {"step":7,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":799,"var":"cwords,words","code":"if (cwords >= words) goto incomplete_msbs;","note":"When the crafted stream ends mid-codeword, control falls into the tail-handling path that assumes more buffered bits will be available."},
  {"step":8,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":811,"var":"lsbs","code":"if(!FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32(br, &lsbs, parameter - ucbits)) return false;","note":"The tail path requests additional bits from the bitreader based on the partially decoded unary prefix."},
  {"step":9,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":391,"var":"bits","code":"while((br->words-br->consumed_words)*FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD + br->bytes*8 - br->consumed_bits < bits) { if(!bitreader_read_from_client_(br)) return false; }","note":"The bitreader repeatedly refills from the client while trying to satisfy the oversized bit request."},
  {"step":10,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"bitreader_read_from_client_","line":196,"var":"target,bytes","code":"if(!br->read_callback(target, &bytes, br->client_data)) return false;","note":"Refill uses the attacker-controlled stream callback, which can return a short tail and leave the reader in a partially initialized state."},
  {"step":11,"file":"flac/src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":866,"var":"br->consumed_bits","code":"br->consumed_bits = FLAC__BITS_PER_WORD - ucbits;","note":"The function commits the updated cursor after the tail path, and the vulnerability hypothesis is that malformed tail-state bookkeeping can drive an out-of-bounds read in subsequent bit extraction."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
